## Maintenance

[snapshot.json](upstream-prs/snapshot.json) owns the candidate mapping, captured GitHub facts and human review notes. Refresh public status with the configured read-only GitHub CLI queries, then regenerate and check:

```powershell
python docs/implementation/upstream-prs/render.py --refresh
python docs/implementation/upstream-prs/render.py --check
```

Refresh preserves review notes and flags changed PR heads. New authored PRs in a listed upstream stop refresh until their mapping is reviewed. Update the human review and next action when discussion or evidence changes; `--check` checks agreement with the captured snapshot, not live GitHub freshness.
